mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has shown net deterioration over the last four weeks (from -24.9 to -25.6, with intermediate recovery reversed), indicating persistent caution-driven momentum. This momentum is expected to continue, producing a further decline in RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks relative to the last four.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC fell from -20.0 at t-2w to -25.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: If mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than the last 28-day mean, the momentum hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained elevated RESIDENTIAL mobility above +9.0 reflects continued at-home behavioral preference that substitutes for discretionary outings. When RESIDENTIAL stays above this threshold for two consecutive weeks, RETAIL_REC is suppressed over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL remains above +9.0 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL was 9.3 and 9.4 in the last two observed weeks
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises over the next two weeks despite RESIDENTIAL staying above +9.0, the threshold mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Joint stabilization of WORKPLACES (around -21 to -24) and TRANSIT (around -26 to -31) indicates a floor in commuting-linked mobility. When both series stabilize together rather than diverge, the combined restoration of commute-adjacent trips lifts RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks via incidental shopping on commute routes.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES ranged -20.9 to -23.9 and TRANSIT ranged -26.1 to -31.0 over the snapshot
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC declines over the next four weeks while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both remain stable or improve, the joint-stabilization mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A PARKS mobility rebound (from -15.6 to as high as +2.3) signals an informal reopening regime where outdoor restrictions have eased. In such a regime, eased policy constraints are expected to extend to indoor commerce with a lag, raising RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from -15.6 at t-3w to +2.3 at t-2w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC fails to rise over the next four weeks despite continued positive or improving PARKS readings, reject the reopening-lag mechanism.

mechanism_narrative: Early spring seasonal increases in outdoor activity (reflected in PARKS variability) temporarily substitute for indoor retail trips, producing a short-term dip in RETAIL_REC within one week of a PARKS uptick before any longer-run recovery.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose sharply from -15.6 to +2.3 then fell back to -17.3
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises in the week immediately following a PARKS increase, the seasonal-substitution hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: The single-week drop in RETAIL_REC at t-0w (-25.6, down from -23.4 the prior week) exceeds typical week-on-week volatility and represents a transient behavioral shock rather than a durable shift. Mean reversion predicts RETAIL_REC will rebound within one week.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC week-on-week drop exceeds 2 points from the prior week value
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC fell from -23.4 to -25.6 in the final observed week
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC continues to decline or stays flat in the week following the observed drop, the mean-reversion hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has remained near baseline and stable (-2.0 to -5.9) across all four weeks, indicating no new essential-services restrictions are in force. In this steady-state policy regime, RETAIL_REC is expected to stabilize rather than decline further over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM stayed within -2.0 to -5.9 across all four weeks
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC declines further over the next two weeks while GROCERY_PHARM remains stable near baseline, the steady-state stabilization hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous softness in TRANSIT, WORKPLACES, and elevated RESIDENTIAL together indicate a compounded reduction in overall mobility capacity and willingness to travel. Where all three co-move in the restrictive direction, RETAIL_REC is pulled down more strongly than any single series would predict, over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT near -28 to -31, WORKPLACES near -21 to -24, RESIDENTIAL near +9 to +10 across the snapshot
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises over the next four weeks despite TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remaining depressed and RESIDENTIAL remaining elevated, the compounded-suppression mechanism is rejected.
